title: SRE: dashboards + alerts for gate evaluation health and rollout stuck/paused conditions
creator: Sean Gallagher
project: Dedicated staged rollouts for reserved pools
description:
We need production-grade observability for Dedicated staged rollouts v1.

Scope:
1) Dashboards to answer:
  - Is the gate evaluator healthy (running, making progress, querying metrics successfully)?
  - Are rollouts getting stuck (no state progression) or paused/held due to gates/approvals/missing metrics?
  - Are we seeing false-positive holds due to metrics latency/missingness?
2) Alerts (paged vs ticket) with clear runbooks for oncall:
  - evaluator degraded / lagging
  - evaluation failures / query errors
  - metrics freshness issues causing fail-safe holds
  - rollouts paused/held for too long
  - rollouts stuck between stages / state-machine errors

Primary consumers:
- SRE oncall (Dedicated)
- Rollouts operators (platform eng + console operators)

Notes / constraints:
- Dedicated pools have high cardinality (pool_id, tenant_id). Dashboards must support per-pool drill-down without making global alerting cardinality explode.
- Missing/late metrics should fail safe (pause). Observability must differentiate: "gate failed" vs "gate could not be evaluated".

Proposed dashboards (Grafana folder: "Dedicated > Staged Rollouts")
A) Gate Evaluator Health
- Evaluator tick lag (time since last successful loop): evaluator_last_success_timestamp / evaluator_tick_lag_seconds
- Eval loop duration percentiles
- Gate evaluation outcomes rate: pass/fail/error/missing_metrics
- Metric query success rate + latency (by backend: prom/tempo/metrics-router)
- Queue depth of evaluator work items (if applicable)
- Concurrency / worker saturation

B) Rollout Status Overview (Dedicated)
- Active rollouts count by state: running / awaiting_approval / paused (auto-hold) / aborted / rolled_back
- Paused rollouts: top N by duration paused
- Stage progression: time in stage distribution (p50/p95) and top N longest stage dwell
- "Stuck" detector: rollouts with no event progression for > X minutes

C) Missing Metrics / Freshness
- Metrics ingestion delay (p95) for the specific signals used by gates: p95 latency, 5xx rate, timeout rate, GPU util, queue depth
- Gate evaluations that returned missing_metrics (rate) by signal type
- Correlate evaluator holds with metrics delays

D) Auto-hold / Rollback signals
- Count of auto-hold events and reason (threshold breach vs missing metrics vs evaluator degraded)
- If we implement auto-rollback in v1.1+, keep the panels but gate behind a feature flag

Alerting plan
Paged (P0):
1) Gate evaluator degraded (production):
  - evaluator_tick_lag_seconds > 180s for 10m (tunable; see evaluation window defaults)
  - OR evaluator loop success rate < 95% for 10m
  - OR evaluator unable to query metrics backend (error rate > 5% for 10m)
  -> Page Dedicated SRE oncall; runbook: "Dedicated staged rollout paused" + evaluator triage section.

2) Rollout safety impact:
  - auto-hold events spike: > 5 holds / 10m across prod dedicated AND holds include missing_metrics/evaluator_degraded
  - OR rollouts stuck between stages: > 3 rollouts with no stage transition for > 45m (excluding awaiting_approval)
  -> Page (this indicates systemic failure, not just one customer/pool).

Ticket (P1/P2):
3) Paused rollouts aging:
  - Any rollout paused for > 60m in production (grouped by pool_id; route to CS/SRE triage)

4) Metrics freshness issues:
  - metrics ingestion delay p95 > 120s for 15m for any gating signal (prod)

Implementation details / guardrails
- Use low-cardinality labels for global alerting: env, region, evaluator_cluster, gate_type, signal_type.
- Allow dashboard drill-down by pool_id (templated variable), but alerts should not fan out by pool_id unless explicitly needed.
- Add annotation stream from audit events (approve/abort/auto-hold) onto rollout dashboards (via Loki/audit-log feed).
- Each alert must link to a runbook section with: how to confirm, how to mitigate (pause advancement, force hold), and who to notify.

Acceptance criteria
- Grafana folder + dashboards live in staging and prod.
- Alert rules merged, tested in staging with synthetic failures (simulated evaluator lag; simulated missing metrics), and validated to not page on expected transient conditions.
- Runbook links included in alert annotations.
- Documented ownership + oncall routing (Dedicated SRE rotation).

References
- Confluence: sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/dedicated-rollout-gate-health-dashboards.json
- ADR-027: gate evaluation approach and failure modes
- Postmortem (dogfood): pm-2025-02-dedicated-rollout-gate-evaluator-lag (alert thresholds should catch this class)
- Eng deps: ENG-5124 (evaluator), ENG-5125 (telemetry), ENG-5126 (console backend status aggregation)
- GitHub: observability-pack/pr_913 (dashboards/alerts scaffolding), redwood/pr_28503 (telemetry plumbing), redwood/pr_28572 (fail-safe hold on evaluator degraded)
comments: 2025-01-16 (Sean Gallagher): Creating this as P0 for Dedicated GA readiness. We had a dogfood incident where evaluator lag delayed the pause; we need paging on evaluator health + systemic hold spikes.

2025-01-22 (Allison Grant): Drafted dashboard outline in Confluence (Dedicated rollout gate health dashboards). Main open question: do we have an explicit "missing_metrics" outcome exported from evaluator yet, or only "error"? If not, we should add as a labeled outcome to avoid ambiguity.

2025-01-24 (Logan Wright): Telemetry side: queue depth + GPU util metrics are landing with ~45–90s ingestion delay in staging. Please avoid alerts <120s until prod pipeline is validated. Also: pool_id is extremely high-card; strongly agree to keep it out of alert labels.

2025-01-30 (Allison Grant): Implemented initial Grafana dashboards in observability-pack/pr_913 (WIP). Added panels: evaluator_tick_lag_seconds, eval_outcome_rate (pass/fail/error/missing), metrics_query_latency, paused_rollouts_count, topN_paused_by_duration. Needs review from SRE + Platform.

2025-02-03 (Rafael Mendes): Alerting feedback: page on evaluator_tick_lag_seconds only if combined with rollout activity (active_rollouts_count > 0). Otherwise we’ll page overnight for idle environments. Also add a separate ticket alert for paused rollouts > 60m (prod).

2025-02-06 (Allison Grant): Updated alerts to include gating condition active_rollouts_count > 0 OR auto_hold_events_rate > 0. Added runbook links to runbook-dedicated-staged-rollout-paused and added a short evaluator triage section draft (pending Kira).

2025-02-11 (Sean Gallagher): Please align thresholds with default evaluation windows from dedicated-rollouts-gating-slos. For p95 latency gate we’re recommending 10m windows; evaluator lag alert should be >2x window (or >180s if we standardize).

2025-02-14 (Allison Grant): Adjusted evaluator lag paging to max(180s, 2x eval_window) where possible; otherwise static 300s in prod. Added "stuck" detector panel: rollouts with no state transition event for >45m (excluding awaiting_approval).

2025-02-18 (Allison Grant): Marking In Review. Dashboards + alerts are ready for staging validation. Next step: run synthetic failure tests (stop evaluator, block metrics backend) during ENG-5132 E2E testing window and confirm paging + noise levels.
